sprint_note: Adds backend/recurrence.py, GET /tasks/agenda, recurrence fields and spawn logic in tasks.py, migration 011, Today tab / Repeat control / toast in the frontend, and new tests.

files.role: Docker Compose service definition — unchanged (no new env vars or ports).
Canonical runtime DDL. Append the Sprint11 block of 10_schema.sql (four recurrence columns).
Idempotent migration adding recurrence_freq, recurrence_interval, recurrence_mode, recurrence_next_id; same statements as the Sprint11 block of 10_schema.sql, wrapped in begin/commit.
Connection pool and schema init — unchanged.
Pure, DB-free recurrence helpers: constants, month arithmetic with day clamp, next-date computation, human label. No imports from routers or database. Authoritative definition of the next-date rule.

public_objects.name: VALID_RECURRENCE_FREQ
public_objects.purpose: Allowed recurrence_freq values: {'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly'}.

public_objects.name: VALID_RECURRENCE_MODE
public_objects.purpose: Allowed recurrence_mode values: {'fixed', 'after_completion'}.

methods.name: add_months
methods.purpose: Return d shifted by months calendar months; day-of-month clamped to the target month's last day (Jan 31 + 1 -> Feb 28/29).

methods.name: advance_date
methods.purpose: Return anchor advanced by steps*interval units (days for daily, 7-day weeks for weekly, add_months for monthly) always measured from anchor, never cumulatively.

methods.name: compute_next_date
methods.purpose: mode 'after_completion' or anchor None: advance_date(today, freq, interval, 1). mode 'fixed': smallest steps >= 1 such that advance_date(anchor, freq, interval, steps) > today. Result is always strictly greater than today.

methods.name: format_recurrence_label
methods.purpose: None when freq is None. interval 1: 'Daily' / 'Weekly' / 'Monthly'; interval n>1: 'Every n days|weeks|months'; when mode is after_completion append ', after completion' (e.g. 'Every 2 weeks', 'Daily, after completion').

files.role: All task HTTP endpoints plus label and preference proxies. Sprint11: agenda endpoint, recurrence fields on create/update, successor spawn, shared TASK_SELECT_COLS.

public_objects.name: router
public_objects.purpose: APIRouter prefix=/tasks, mounted by main.py under /api.

public_objects.name: TASK_SCHEMA
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] ColumnSchema list for task Datasets; adds recurrence_freq, recurrence_interval, recurrence_mode, recurrence_next_id, recurrence_label, recurrence_next_date.

public_objects.name: AGENDA_SCHEMA
public_objects.purpose: [NEW] TASK_SCHEMA plus ColumnSchema entries agenda_bucket (enum) and agenda_date (date).

public_objects.name: TASK_SELECT_COLS
public_objects.purpose: [NEW] Comma-separated column list used by list_tasks and list_agenda: id, title, description, status, priority, due_date, effort_hours, created_at, updated_at, task_type, parent_task_id, actual_duration_minutes, completed_at, scheduled_at, recurrence_freq, recurrence_interval, recurrence_mode, recurrence_next_id. Replaces list_tasks' local select_cols.

public_objects.name: AGENDA_WINDOW_DAYS
public_objects.purpose: [NEW] 7 — upper bound of the upcoming bucket (today + 7 days inclusive).

public_objects.name: VALID_STATUS
public_objects.purpose: open, in_progress, scheduled, pending, done — unchanged.

public_objects.name: VALID_PRIORITY
public_objects.purpose: low, medium, high — unchanged.

public_objects.name: VALID_VIEW
public_objects.purpose: active, pending_board, scheduled — unchanged ('agenda' is NOT a view value; it is a separate endpoint).

public_objects.name: TaskCreate
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Request body for POST /api/tasks; existing fields unchanged, three recurrence fields added (listed fields are the additions only).

public_objects.name: TaskUpdate
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Request body for PATCH. Existing fields unchanged; three recurrence fields added (additions only listed). All three, and due_date, are applied via model_fields_set (omit = unchanged; explicit null semantics per 10_architecture.json PATCH surface).

public_objects.name: LabelAttachBody
public_objects.purpose: POST /{task_id}/labels body — unchanged.

public_objects.name: LabelFilterPutBody
public_objects.purpose: PUT /preferences/label_filter body — unchanged.

public_objects.name: LabelSetBody
public_objects.purpose: PUT /{task_id}/labels body — unchanged.

private_objects.name: CALENDAR_CONNECTOR_URL
private_objects.purpose: CalendarConnector base URL, empty disables — unchanged.

private_objects.name: _sync_calendar_event
private_objects.purpose: Best-effort calendar sync — unchanged; also called for scheduled recurrence successors with action 'create'.

private_objects.name: row_to_dict
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] As before, plus str() of recurrence_next_id, derived recurrence_label via format_recurrence_label, and recurrence_next_date defaulting to None.

private_objects.name: fetch_labels_for_tasks
private_objects.purpose: Batch label fetch; empty dict on failure — unchanged.

private_objects.name: single_row_dataset
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Wrap one task row in a Dataset (TASK_SCHEMA); extra keys, if given, are merged into the serialized row after row_to_dict (used to inject recurrence_next_date).

private_objects.name: _run_auto_promotion
private_objects.purpose: Promote due scheduled tasks to in_progress within caller's connection — unchanged (list_agenda commits afterwards).

private_objects.name: _validate_recurrence
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Merged-state recurrence validation (internal_flow step 10): returns an error message or None. freq None -> always None. Otherwise enforces freq/mode enums, interval >= 1, task_type == 'normal', and (mode == 'fixed' and status != 'done') requires due_date or scheduled_at.

private_objects.name: _spawn_successor
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Run internal_flow step 11 on the caller's cursor/transaction: select current_date, derive schedule_date/anchor, call compute_next_date, INSERT successor, UPDATE source recurrence_next_id. pre = locked snapshot row, post = RETURNING * row. Returns the successor row dict plus key 'next_date' (date). Does not commit.

private_objects.name: _copy_labels_best_effort
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] GET source labels from LabelEngine and POST each label name to the successor (object_type=task). Catches and logs all exceptions; never raises. Call after commit only.

private_objects.name: list_tasks
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] GET /api/tasks — behaviour unchanged; uses TASK_SELECT_COLS instead of local select_cols.

private_objects.name: create_task
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] POST /api/tasks — adds recurrence validation/normalisation and inserts recurrence_* columns (internal_flow steps 3, 10).

private_objects.name: update_task
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id} — FOR UPDATE snapshot, recurrence validation, due_date explicit-null fix, spawn in-transaction, post-commit calendar/label side effects (internal_flow steps 4, 10, 11, 12).

files.role: Shell registration. Add Today entry (id tasks-today, path /tasks, order 1) to mobilePrimaryNav and desktopNav; Active moves to /tasks/active (order 2); Scheduled/Pending/Done become orders 3/4/5.
Main React entry. Sprint11: Today view, RepeatControl, repeat icon on TaskCard, next-date toast, extended TaskRow, route mapping.

public_objects.name: TasksPage

public_objects.name: TodayAgenda
public_objects.purpose: [NEW] Renders Overdue / Today / Next 7 days sections from agenda rows (already label-filtered): section headers with effort sums, upcoming grouped by agenda_date, empty state, TaskCard rows.

public_objects.name: RepeatControl

public_objects.name: NextToast
public_objects.purpose: [NEW] Small auto-dismissing toast showing 'Next: <date>'.

public_objects.name: TaskCard

public_objects.name: TaskCreatePanel

public_objects.name: TaskDetailEdit
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Adds RepeatControl initialised from the row; always sends all three recurrence fields on PATCH; shows recurrence_label; passes the PATCH response row to onSaved so TasksPage can show the toast.

private_objects.name: sumEffort
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Sum effort_hours over rows treating null/undefined as 0.
